introHtml: Orange mouse pads make a bold statement in any office, standing out against standard black or gray. Our custom orange mouse pads are available in various sizes and materials, from cloth-top for smooth tracking to rubber base for desk grip. Add your full-color logo with screen printing or dye sublimation for lasting impact.
